result.reason: The redline appropriately limits exclusivity to Deerskin Products and 12 months, but it does not fully reach the fallback. The performance exit applies only to material obligations under specified sections and only after written notice and a 30-day cure period, rather than ending automatically upon any failure to meet applicable service levels or delivery dates. The edits are otherwise targeted and preserve the unrelated term and termination provisions. The margin comment is also inaccurate in stating that HDI's Section 6.1 exclusivity is unaffected, because that exclusive right is expressly limited and made terminable by the redline.
